actions.name: Conducted credential guessing
actions.description: Unit 26165 actors used credential guessing and brute force to gain initial access to targeted entities.

actions.name: Sent spearphishing emails with credential harvesting links
actions.description: GRU unit 26165 actors sent spearphishing emails including links leading to fake login pages impersonating government entities and Western cloud email providers.

actions.name: Sent spearphishing emails delivering malware executables
actions.description: Actors used spearphishing to deliver malware executables including HEADLACE and MASEPIE via third-party services and redirectors.

actions.name: Exploited Outlook NTLM vulnerability CVE-2023-23397
actions.description: GRU unit 26165 weaponized an Outlook NTLM vulnerability (CVE-2023-23397) to collect NTLM hashes and credentials via specially crafted Outlook calendar appointment invitations.

actions.name: Exploited Roundcube vulnerabilities CVE-2020-12641, CVE-2020-35730, CVE-2021-44026
actions.description: Actors used Roundcube CVEs to execute arbitrary shell commands, gain access to victim email accounts, and retrieve sensitive data from email servers.

actions.name: Exploited WinRAR vulnerability CVE-2023-38831
actions.description: Actors leveraged a WinRAR vulnerability allowing execution of arbitrary code embedded in an archive as a means of initial access.

actions.name: Conducted contact information reconnaissance
actions.description: After initial compromise, unit 26165 actors conducted contact information reconnaissance to identify additional targets in key positions including cybersecurity departments and transport coordinators.

actions.name: Moved laterally using native commands, Impacket, PsExec, and RDP
actions.description: Actors used native commands and open source tools such as Impacket and PsExec, and Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) to move laterally within the environment.

actions.name: Attempted to dump Active Directory NTDS.dit domain databases
actions.description: Actors attempted to dump Active Directory NTDS.dit domain databases using native Active Directory Domain Services commands.

actions.name: Used Certipy and ADExplorer.exe to exfiltrate Active Directory information
actions.description: Actors used Certipy and ADExplorer.exe tools to exfiltrate information from Active Directory, installing python to enable Certipy execution.

actions.name: Archived accessed files in .zip files prior to exfiltration
actions.description: Accessed files were archived in .zip files prior to exfiltration.

actions.name: Attempted to exfiltrate archived data via previously dropped OpenSSH binary
actions.description: Actors attempted to exfiltrate archived data using a previously dropped OpenSSH binary.

actions.name: Manipulated mailbox permissions to establish sustained email collection
actions.description: Actors manipulated mailbox permissions to establish sustained email collection at compromised logistics entities.

actions.name: Changed accounts' folder permissions and enrolled compromised accounts in MFA
actions.description: After initial authentication, actors changed accounts' folder permissions and enrolled compromised accounts in MFA mechanisms to increase trust-level and enable sustained access.

actions.name: Used python scripts to retrieve plaintext passwords via Group Policy Preferences
actions.description: Actors used python scripts such as Get-GPPPassword.py to retrieve plaintext passwords via Group Policy Preferences and conducted brute force password spray via LDAP.

actions.name: Deleted event logs through the wevtutil utility
actions.description: Actors deleted event logs using the legitimate Windows executable wevtutil.

actions.name: Attempted to gain access to IP camera feeds
actions.description: Unit 26165 actors attempted to enumerate RTSP servers hosting IP cameras and gain access to the cameras’ feeds primarily located in Ukraine and bordering countries.

actions.name: Sent RTSP DESCRIBE requests with Base64-encoded credentials to IP cameras
actions.description: Actor-controlled servers sent RTSP DESCRIBE requests including Base64-encoded credentials, including default and brute forced credentials, to access IP cameras on logically distinct networks.

actions.name: Used multi-stage redirectors verifying IP-geolocation and browser fingerprints
actions.description: Some spearphishing campaigns employed multi-stage redirectors verifying IP-geolocation and browser fingerprints to protect credential harvesting infrastructure and provide MFA and CAPTCHA relaying.

actions.name: Attempted voice phishing to gain privileged account access
actions.description: In at least one instance, actors attempted voice phishing by impersonating IT staff to gain access to privileged accounts.
